kinds.description: The package's own index — links to every other required document and marks a directory as a design package.
The real need, market, or context this work responds to — not just its technical symptom.
Candidate directions, evaluated and ranked, with rejected options recorded.
Feasibility evidence actually run, not assumed.
The real user workflow, mapped to stories and a walking-skeleton release.
Concrete enough to start implementation from directly.
The reusable technique and lessons, for whoever extends this work later.

rules.description: Every design package must include and link to its own problem-space.md — skipping it means no one recorded WHY this work matters.
rules.name: requires

rules.description: Every design package must include and link to its own solution-space.md — skipping it means alternatives were never actually weighed.

rules.description: Every design package must include and link to its own spikes.md — skipping it means claims rest on assumption, not evidence.
rules.name: requires

rules.description: Every design package must include and link to its own story-map.md — skipping it means there's no real user workflow behind the plan.
rules.name: requires

rules.description: Every design package must include and link to its own roadmap.md — skipping it means there's no sequencing or migration plan.
rules.name: requires

rules.description: Every design package must include and link to its own implementation-details.md — skipping it means the design isn't concrete enough to start from.
rules.name: requires

rules.description: Every design package must include and link to its own knowledge.md — skipping it means lessons learned won't reach whoever extends this next.

rules.description: A cost/feasibility/risk claim needs real evidence — cite the spike that backs it.
rules.name: grounded_by

rules.description: A sequencing decision needs real evidence — cite the spike that justifies it.

rules.description: A risk/investment claim needs real evidence — cite the spike that backs it.

rules.description: An implementation approach must be built on a validated primitive, not assumed — cite the spike that confirmed it works.

rules.description: Instructional guidance restating a spike's findings must cite the spike it's sourced from, so a reader can verify it's still accurate.
rules.name: sourced_from

rules.description: A roadmap that realizes a story-map concept (e.g. a walking skeleton) must cite the story-map doc it derives from.
rules.name: derived_from

rules.description: The originating GitHub issue must be linked from problem-space.md — the evidence basis this design package rests on. See docs/design/CONVENTION.md's "Linking to a dev issue" section.
